narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -8.42 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 2.175-2.200 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip) — the trigger is still pending. Risk is defined beyond 2.310; the first objective pays 1.49R at 2.134.

plan.triggerRule: await bearish footprint confirmation (absorption / strong divergence / trap) or wall+CVD confluence at 2.175-2.200
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 2.310 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 R 1.49 < 1.5 — reward does not pay the risk

athena_oracle.verdict: Cautious bearish lean 36/100 — trend broken, liq magnets below, whales offering
